name: signal-dispatch
description: Deterministic enforcement of the 'hey' signal dispatch prefix. Reads table-matched patterns from patterns.txt (single source of truth). Blocks non-dispatch tool calls when a hey-prefixed prompt is detected, injecting a JIT reminder to call search_nodes first. KGM tool name comes from scripts/agentfs-contract.sh; a wrong-prefix search_nodes gets one mismatch notice.
